messages:
tom: Heads-up 1: our CI started reporting ~140 new SAST findings after we merged the keystore RBAC tweak this AM. Most look like token-carrier matches, not clear creds. Can we triage quickly?
hana: Which RBAC PR exactly?
tom: https://git.internal/rad/infra/pulls/820 (grant: ci-keystore-reader). The scan run id is 214009.
security-bot: Auto-upload: scan id=214009, ruleset=stable-3. Report: https://scans.internal/214009/report (redacted). Reaction :robot_face:.
mike: Sample hit (sanitized):
```
FILE: infra/helm/values-prod.yaml:101
FINDING: aws-access-key-literal
MATCH: AKIAFFFFYYYYZZZZZZ
CONTEXT: value = 'carrier:sealed-keystore:v1:AKIAFFFFYYYYZZZZZZ'
```
olivia: That carrier prefix was added by the new keystore pipeline. Scanner regex is matching AKIA inside the carrier. We should avoid flagging tokens that are encapsulated.
hana: Agreed. Short-term: collect a representative hit list, attach helm values + carrier manifests, and run CloudTrail/KMS decrypt audit for principal=ci-builder@redwood.internal during window 2026-03-25T11:10Z-11:30Z. Who can pull audit logs?
mike: I can run the audit. Will check for Decrypt events and attach request IDs.
tom: Also propose a scoped suppression in scanner-configs with TTL=72h scoped to infra/helm/** while we validate. Include evidence and approver.
security-bot: Suppression template prefilled: author=@tom, justification="sealed-keystore carrier encoding causing FP after RBAC change", expires=72h, evidence_url=https://tickets.internal/SEC-1422/evidence.tar.gz.
olivia: For the longer-term fix: change detector regex to ignore AKIA-like matches when preceded by 'carrier:sealed' or 'sealed-keystore' prefixes. Example regex idea: `(?<!carrier:sealed[-_]keystore:v[0-9]+:)\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b`. Add unit tests that cover carrier variants.
hana: Good idea. Also add detector logic: if a match is inside a value containing 'carrier:' mark as low-confidence and surface the carrier metadata to the analyst UI. That reduces noisy blocks.
mike: Audit query result: no KMS Decrypt events for ci-builder in 11:10-11:30Z. Attached CloudTrail excerpt to SEC-1422. Looks like the carrier was never materialized during that CI run.
tom: That's reassuring. I'll open the suppression PR with the evidence bundle; please review and tag approver @hana.
mike: PR: https://git.internal/scanner-configs/pulls/541. Includes hit sample and CloudTrail excerpt.
hana: Reviewing evidence. Two real creds were found in a legacy migration file outside of carriers; I created a rotate ticket and assigned to app-owner. Those are separate and high priority.
olivia: After locally applying the regex patch, noisy hits went from 140 -> 5. Manual review indicates 4 are legit (including the migration one) and 1 is a different carrier type we missed. Will add that variant to test corpus.
tom: Action list: (1) Mike attach audit & evidence (done), (2) Tom open suppression PR (done), (3) Olivia push regex + unit tests to ruleset-candidate branch, (4) Hana approves suppression after evidence review, (5) Revoke suppression when ruleset merges.
security-bot: Note: suppression PR template will auto-revoke when ruleset-candidate merges to production per policy.
hana: Approving suppression after review. Approve now.
mike: Confirmed rotation ticket for legacy migration secret: https://tickets.internal/OPS-778 (in progress).
olivia: Pushed ruleset candidate branch: scanner-configs:patch/ignore-sealed-carriers. Tests include sealed-keystore:v1/v2 and a negative set of real keys. CI run shows FP reduction ~96%.
tom: One more recommendation: add a short runbook addendum under docs/playbooks/sdlc-scans.md titled "RBAC/Keystore changes -> scan noise" that instructs on checking carrier formats and querying KMS/CloudTrail before suppression. Who wants to add it?
hana: I'll add the one-liner and link to SEC-1422.
olivia: Also filing a follow-up console UX ticket to surface recent keystore RBAC changes next to scan-volume spikes to help oncall correlate faster: https://git.internal/console/issue/1227.
tom: Thanks all. I'll mark thread resolved once ruleset is promoted and the legacy secret rotation is verified in prod. :white_check_mark:
